analyst.summary: Subros is India's dominant auto air-conditioning maker, backed by strong technology (Denso) and commercial (Suzuki) partners, and has used the last decade to become nearly debt-free while steadily growing sales and profit at low-double-digit rates. It is investing in EV and hybrid thermal-management systems, a sensible move as vehicles electrify. Return on equity remains modest, working-capital efficiency has drifted slightly worse over the years, and the business still depends heavily on the Maruti Suzuki relationship - none of which are alarming on their own, but together they keep this a steady-compounder Hold rather than a name with a clear re-rating case.
